Verification and limits

The final History/full-screen source passed its cold build and full suite, including 263 app-safety checks, with real stores unchanged. Local main has the same application source.

Spoken VoiceOver, live display capture, hardware-dependent paths and some full-screen transitions remain unverified. History hover, pressed and focus images are harness-driven states. The OS-owned titlebar keeps its native font; application action labels use 20pt.

Known remaining work
  • Manual VoiceOver and global capture verification; 1x and multiple displays.
  • Populated Photos, printer output, held-modifier gestures and cross-app drag/drop.
  • Small-canvas space choices and erased-shadow semantics.
  • Window restoration fixes have regression coverage. History-open size and AX selection worked on the baseline and now have guard checks.
  • Live transition animation, spoken VoiceOver and real History hover/Tab still need manual acceptance.
